phases.goal: Use the right arm to push or turn the trapezoid switch.
phases.name: engage_switch
phases.verify: The switch contact surface is engaged by the right TCP.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Right TCP aligns with the switch contact surface.
Push direction engages the switch instead of stopping short.

task_language: Command the right arm to engage the light-colored trapezoid-shaped plastic switch
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 3:move_to(arm=right,gripper=keep,orientation=keep). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid repeating a push that stops short; relocalize the right TCP approach and verify direct contact with the trapezoid switch surface.
